description: HP-89 is the Regional Transport Office/Registration and Licensing Authority serving the Jhandutta sub-division of Bilaspur district in Himachal Pradesh. The office is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcement of transport regulations under the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil).
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Jhandutta, District Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh
